title: Door Bottom Strip – Seals Against Noise, Drafts & Dust
descriptionHtml:
The floor draft always finds its way under the door

The gap under the door lets in cold air, hallway noise and dust – and the heat you pay for slips out the same way.

A strip you cut to fit your door and close the gap

Attach the self-adhesive hook-and-loop tape along the bottom edge of the door, cut the strip to the right width with ordinary scissors and press it in place. The foam tube sits tight against the floor – and moves with the door every time it opens and closes.

Features

  • Drafts stay outside – the foam tube seals tightly against the floor
  • The neighbors' noise is dampened – the gap the sound leaks through disappears
  • Cut to fit your door – 94 cm long, trimmed with ordinary scissors
  • Stays on without tools – self-adhesive hook-and-loop strip, no screws
  • Moves with the door – open and close as usual, the strip stays put

Change of Mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
